summary: Mobile Performance was held back by a scrolling logo ticker and five oversized portfolio images. Accessibility had one contrast failure inside a dropdown. Both are fixed; the ticker swap is waiting for your OK.

fixed.title: Five portfolio card images resized
fixed.detail: Each was 3000px wide shown at 560px. PageSpeed did not flag them because they load below the fold. 4.1 MB saved.

fixed.title: Contrast in the Budget dropdown
fixed.detail: The option text resolved to #9CA3AF on white (2.5:1) through a component variant, not the token. Now #4B5563 (7.6:1).

fixed.title: Meta descriptions on 9 pages
fixed.detail: Including the blog article template, 404 and both legal pages.

ask.title: Replace the logo ticker with a looping video
ask.why: The ticker animates 28 elements on every frame, which adds blocking time on phones.
ask.impact: Mobile Performance +5 to 8. I can make the video for you.

ask.title: Drop the Inter 300 weight
ask.why: It is used only in the footer note.

console: No errors after the fixes. Before: 2 errors from an unused Calendly embed.
